tested:
Keysight Ixia-c-one (open-traffic-generator all-in-one). Vendor minimum
(Keysight docs: 2 vCPU / 4GB for the all-in-one - inner dockerd + controller +
a traffic+protocol engine pair per port, protocol-engine image alone is 1.6GB;
probe-verified live 2026-07-16) - matches the launch-time floor already enforced
in docker_provider.py's _CONTAINER_NOS_LAUNCH ("min_cpu": 2, "min_ram_mb": 4096)
so the Library/palette-shown default and the actually-enforced minimum agree.
Found 2026-07-18 device audit: this entry was MISSING, so image-manager fell back
to the generic profile (1 vCPU / 512MB) for the Inspector-displayed hardware
defaults - launch-time enforcement in docker_provider.py meant the node still
booted correctly (floor bump live-verified), but rule 14 step 5 ("hardware
defaults set from the vendor recommendation") was violated: the displayed default
silently understated the real requirement by 8x RAM / 2x CPU.

settings.description: Keysight Ixia-c-one all-in-one OTG traffic generator - needs >=2 vCPU / 4GB to boot cleanly (inner dockerd + controller + per-port engine pairs).
